items.title: Pakistan beat Sri Lanka by 8 wickets to win Test series 1-0
items.summary: Pakistan defeated Sri Lanka by eight wickets on the fourth morning of the second Test at the Rawalpindi International Cricket Stadium today, securing the two-match series 1-0 after the opening match ended in a draw.

items.title: 325,616 raids, 324,780 arrests under ‘Ratama Ekata’
items.summary: Sri Lanka Police have arrested 324,780 suspects during 325,616 raids conducted islandwide under the ‘Ratama Ekata’ national anti-drug operation between October 30, 2025, and November 19, 2026.

items.title: Failure to utilize capital development funds has slowed economic growth: Opposition MP
